                    print(2); print(*ops); return
                elif len(l1_intervals)>1:
                    r1b,bi2=l1_intervals[1]
                    if l2<=r1b+1:
                        ops=[0]*M; ops[bi2]=1; ops[j]=1
                        print(2); print(*ops); return

    # Case B: Op1 on i + Op2 on j: need [Lj,Rj] ⊆ [Li,Ri]
    sorted_by_L = sorted(range(M), key=lambda i: (intervals[i][0], -intervals[i][1]))
    top_r = (-1, -1); top_r2 = (-1, -1)
    ptr = 0
    for j in sorted(range(M), key=lambda j: (intervals[j][0], -intervals[j][1])):
        Lj, Rj = intervals[j]
        while ptr < M and intervals[sorted_by_L[ptr]][0] <= Lj:
            ii = sorted_by_L[ptr]
            r = intervals[ii][1]
            if r > top_r[0]: top_r2=top_r; top_r=(r,ii)
            elif r > top_r2[0]: top_r2=(r,ii)
            ptr+=1
        for (r,i) in [top_r, top_r2]:
            if i != j and r >= Rj:
                ops=[0]*M; ops[i]=1; ops[j]=2
                print(2); print(*ops); return
                break

    # Case C: Two Op2: complement([Li,Ri]) ∪ complement([Lj,Rj]) = [1..N]
    # iff [Li,Ri] ∩ [Lj,Rj] = empty iff Ri < Lj or Rj < Li
    sorted_by_R = sorted(range(M), key=lambda i: intervals[i][1])
    Rs = [intervals[sorted_by_R[k]][1] for k in range(M)]
    Ls = [intervals[sorted_by_R[k]][0] for k in range(M)]
    suffix_maxL = [-1]*M; suffix_maxL_idx=[-1]*M
    cur_max=-1; cur_idx=-1
    for k in range(M-1,-1,-1):
        if Ls[k]>cur_max: cur_max=Ls[k]; cur_idx=sorted_by_R[k]
        suffix_maxL[k]=cur_max; suffix_maxL_idx[k]=cur_idx
    for k in range(M):
        i=sorted_by_R[k]; Ri=intervals[i][1]
        if k+1<M and suffix_maxL[k+1]>Ri:
            j=suffix_maxL_idx[k+1]
            ops=[0]*M; ops[i]=2; ops[j]=2
            print(2); print(*ops); return

    print(-1)

solve()
